-- Compiled proof, equivalent to #print DY.Trace.Reachable_implies_Invariant
theorem DY.Trace.Reachable_implies_Invariant :
∀ [inst : DY.ExecTraceTypes] [inst_1 : DY.ProofTraceTypes] [inst_2 : DY.TraceInvariant] (config : DY.ReachabilityConfig)
  [inst_3 : DY.ReachableImpliesInvariant config] (trExec : DY.ExecTrace),
  DY.Trace.Reachable config trExec → ∃ trProof, DY.Trace.erase trProof = trExec ∧ DY.Trace.Invariant trProof
:=
fun [DY.ExecTraceTypes] [DY.ProofTraceTypes] [DY.TraceInvariant] config [DY.ReachableImpliesInvariant config] trExec
    h_reach =>
  DY.Trace.Reachable.rec (Exists.intro DY.Trace.nil ⟨Eq.refl DY.Trace.nil.erase, True.intro⟩)
    (fun {tr} input a a_1 a_ih =>
      Exists.casesOn a_ih fun trProofMid h =>
        And.casesOn h fun left right =>
          have h_wp :=
            DY.HoareTriple.pf trProofMid (of_eq_true (Eq.trans (congrArg (config.PreCond input) left) (eq_true a)))
              right;
          Exists.casesOn h_wp fun trProofEnd h_wp =>
            Exists.intro trProofEnd
              (DY.Trace.Reachable_implies_Invariant._proof_1_2✝ config input trProofMid left trProofEnd h_wp))
    h_reach
